theme.rationale: High-end beauty products (Progroom Beauty / Zm Store) require a premium, immersive experience. The dark navy base creates depth, while golden/champagne accents signify luxury and high value. The design preserves the original dark navy/blue gradient while elevating visual polish using glassmorphism and enhanced lighting.

rules.headings: Bold weight, pure white. RTL alignment mandatory.
rules.body: Regular weight, secondary text color. RTL alignment mandatory.
rules.currency: IQD must be clearly legible next to the price with proper RTL spacing.

rtl_rules: Use I18nManager.isRTL to adapt layouts. App is entirely in Kurdish Sorani.
CRITICAL: Always use marginStart/marginEnd and paddingStart/paddingEnd instead of Left/Right for true RTL support in React Native.
Text alignment must be 'right' (or 'auto' with RTL) to ensure Kurdish text reads naturally.

auth_screen.background: Deep navy gradient with subtle ambient glow (#0A1228 to #1E3A8A).
auth_screen.logo: Sparkle emoji with 'Zm Store' in bold NotoSansArabic.
auth_screen.buttons: Glassmorphism cards for Google/Apple, solid gold accent button for primary actions. Must fix Google sign-in logic.
auth_screen.inputs: Floating label inputs with gold focus state. Soft glassmorphic background.

product_card.shadow: Subtle dark shadow for depth (shadowColor: '#000', shadowOpacity: 0.3).

primary.style: Solid vibrant fill to draw attention.

status_badges.style: Small pill-shaped containers with 15% opacity background of the badge color and solid text of the badge color.

banners.description: Dark blue gradient background for hero banners
Deep blue background with subtle curved lines for promotional banners

products.description: Luxury cosmetic product on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the dark navy luxury theme requested by the user.
Implement glassmorphism using React Native's blur views or rgba backgrounds with semi-transparent borders.

Address the Google Sign-in error: Verify the Expo AuthSession/GoogleSignin configuration. Check for missing webClientId, mismatched SHA-1 fingerprints in the Google Cloud Console, or unhandled promise rejections during the sign-in flow. Add clear user-facing error messages in Kurdish.

RTL MUST BE PERFECT: App is in Kurdish Sorani. Ensure I18nManager.forceRTL(true) is respected. Map all directional properties correctly (use marginStart/End, paddingStart/End, borderStart/End instead of Left/Right).
Apply NotoSansArabic to all Text components to ensure proper rendering of Kurdish script.
Every interactive or critical element MUST use a testID property (e.g., testID="login-google-button") to ensure tests pass.
